description: This PHP source file defines the ReportGroup class within the OrangeHRM project, representing report group entities with properties such as id, name, and coreSql, along with their respective getter and setter methods. It is part of a Doctrine ORM mapped entity for the database table 'ohrm_report_group'.

classes.name: ReportGroup
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing a report group, with constants defining report group types and properties for id, name, and coreSql with relevant getters and setters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the report group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the report group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report group.

methods.name: getCoreSql
methods.description: Returns the core SQL string associated with the report group.

methods.name: setCoreSql
methods.description: Sets the core SQL string for the report group.
